babymean.cta: Which one is SO your baby?
babymean.title_template: What babies really mean: {topic} | The Crib Committee #shorts
babymean.intro: If babies could explain themselves... Today:

pairs: When I fight sleep at 8pm,
I'm so tired I forgot how to stop.
When I wake at 3am just to see you,
I'm checking you're still there.
When I only nap on you,
you're my favourite place in the world.
When I throw my spoon on the floor,
I'm doing science. Gravity still works.
When I refuse broccoli again,
keep offering. One day I might try it.
When I eat off your plate,
your food is the food I trust.
When I cry the moment you leave,
I love you, and I'm learning you come back.
When I cry and you can't tell why,
just hold me. That's enough.
When I cry at new faces,
I'm not rude, just a tiny bit unsure.
When I scream because my banana broke,
my feelings are bigger than my body.
When I go floppy on the floor,
I need you calm, not a lecture.
When I stomp my feet,
show me what to do with mad.
When I empty every cupboard,
I'm learning where things live.
When I want the same game twenty times,
repeating is how my brain learns.
When I play with the box, not the toy,
the box can be anything.
When I grab your phone,
I want what has your attention.
When I bring you a book while you scroll,
pick me, just for five minutes.
When I pretend to tap a remote,
I'm learning everything from you.
When I shout 'me do it!',
let me try, even if it's slow.
When my shoes are on the wrong feet,
I did it myself, and I'm proud.
When I say no to everything,
I'm finding out I'm my own person.
When I splash the whole bathroom,
bath time is my favourite show.
When I cry at hair washing,
water in my eyes feels scary.
When I won't get out,
warm water feels like a hug.
When I cling to your leg at nursery,
say goodbye, then trust me to be brave.
When I ignore you at pickup,
I held it together all day.
When I'm extra wild at home,
home is where I can let it all out.
When I babble at you for ages,
talk back. We're having a conversation.
When I point and shout 'dat!',
tell me the word for it.
When I say a word wrong,
say it back the right way, kindly.
When I want to hold the new baby,
I'm practising being big.
When I act like a baby again,
I'm checking there's still room for me.
When I take my sister's toy,
sharing is really, really hard.
When I stop to stare at a snail,
no rush. This is my nature documentary.
When I jump in every puddle,
wellies were made for this.
When I collect sticks,
they're all treasure, I promise.
When I ask for one more story,
I don't want our day to end.
When I need water, then a hug, then a song,
I'm stretching our time together.
When I want the same song every night,
same feels safe.
When I run off after my bath,
freedom! Then pyjamas. Fine.
When I insist on wearing the cape,
I feel braver in it.
When I refuse my coat,
give me two to choose from.
When I show you my scribble,
tell me what you see, not just 'good job'.
When I clap for myself,
I'm proud. Clap with me!
When I try again after falling,
notice the trying, not just the winning.
When I'm scared of the hoover,
it's loud and I'm small.
When I hide behind your legs,
I'm brave, just warming up slowly.
When the dark feels scary,
your voice makes it smaller.
When I 'help' you unload the dishwasher,
it's slower, but I'm learning I matter.
When I sweep and make it worse,
thank me anyway.
When I want to carry the shopping,
give me the bread. I'll be proud all day.
When I chew everything,
my mouth is busy and curious.
When I'm grumpy for no reason,
there's usually a reason. Be patient.
When I want cuddles all day,
some days I just need you more.
When I paint with my yoghurt,
I'm exploring textures, artistically.
When I feed myself and miss,
practice is messy. Let me keep going.
When I want to sit at the big table,
I want to eat just like you.
When I chew the book,
I love it in every way I know.
When I turn three pages at once,
I'm in charge of the story now.
When I bring the same book again,
I love knowing what happens next.
When I say 'watch me!' fifty times,
I just want you to see me.
When I act up right after you sit down,
I miss you already.
When I climb into your lap,
no reason. Just love.
When I yell in the car seat,
I'm bored and I can't see you.
When I fall asleep five minutes from home,
sorry, the car is magic.
When I wave at every lorry,
waving is my favourite hobby.
When I melt down leaving the park,
warn me five minutes before.
When I won't stop playing,
switching is hard for small brains.
When I want to choose the cup,
small choices help me cooperate.
When I snatch a toy back,
I don't have the words yet. Teach me.
When you say sorry to me,
I learn sorry from you.
When I hug my friend too hard,
I'm still learning gentle.
When I grab everything at the shop,
everything is new and shiny to me.
When I lie down in the aisle,
I'm overwhelmed. Let's take a break.
When I want to put things in the trolley,
give me a job and I'll shine.
When you're tired and I'm still awake,
it's okay to ask for help.
When you snap, then hug me,
making up matters more than perfect.
When you take a break,
a rested you is my favourite you.
When I run to Grandma first,
she has biscuits and time.
When I fall asleep on Grandad,
he's the comfiest chair.
When I'm shy with them at first,
I just need a minute to remember.
When I squeal at a dog,
everything fluffy is my friend.
When I reach for the cat's tail,
teach me gentle hands.
When I meow at you,
we're pretending. Please meow back.
When I bounce to every song,
my body loves music before I know words.
When I bang pots and pans,
I'm a drummer. Find me a spoon.
When I want you to sing,
your voice is my favourite song.
When I tell you after the accident,
I'm learning to notice. That's progress.
When I want to flush ten times,
flushing is fascinating.
When I sit on the potty for ages,
I'm thinking. Give me time.
